backgrounds.label: Reactive halo
backgrounds.css: .glow { position: absolute; inset: -20%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 90%, rgba(255,45,149,0.35), transparent 60%); opacity: calc(0.25 + var(--rpm-ratio, 0) * 0.75); transition: opacity 200ms linear; } .scan { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(34,211,238,0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px); }

backgrounds.label: Vanishing grid
backgrounds.css: .backdrop { background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0 1px, transparent 1px 40px); }
